text:
maria.g: starting midnight canary for embed-service v2.4.1, routing 10% traffic to canary. change window 00:00-01:00 UTC. running smoke tests now. @oncall

deploy-bot: Canary step initiated: service=embed-service env=prod canary=10% version=2.4.1 link: https://deploy.redwood/ops/12345

monitoring-bot: Baseline SLOs loaded: p95 latency=180ms, error_rate=0.4% thresholds: p95>300ms OR errors>1.0% -> alert

jonathan.k: watching dashboards now — opening p95+errors dashboard: https://dash.redwood/s/slo/embed-service

samir: smoke tests returning OK on /health and /v1/encode, no obvious errors from canary pods

elaine: seeing a small blip in 500s on the first minute from a single pod, tailing logs:
```
embed-service-2.4.1 pod-72f: 2026-03-18T00:01:12Z ERROR encode failed: upstream timeout
```

monitoring-bot: Alert triggered: embed-service errors (5xx) rate=1.4% (>1.0%) over 1m window. Alert severity=high

maria.g: rolling back traffic to 0% for canary until we confirm. pin current stable (2.4.0) for the route. @deploy-bot run rollback

deploy-bot: Rollback command queued: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/embed-service --to-revision=stable-2.4.0` — starting

jonathan.k: quick check — p95 and errors in last 5m: p95=220ms, errors=0.6% (still above baseline but trending down)

samir: logs suggest transient upstream timeout from cache-service. adding link to cache metrics: https://dash.redwood/metrics/cache-service

elaine: after rollback, re-checking canary logs — new pods back to stable image, no new 5xx spikes

oncall: documenting incident in #incidents and adding note to the release notes: "Canary for embed-service v2.4.1 rolled back after 5xx spike; root cause suspected cache-service timeouts. Investigating."

maria.g: decision: abort tonight's roll and create follow-up PR to add retry logic + circuit breaker for upstream calls. scheduling a patch canary once fix is validated. Thanks all :heart:
